name: Smack the Brainrot
desc:
🧠 Smack the Brainrots

💥 Brainrots are popping up EVERYWHERE — grab your hammer and SMACK ‘EM! 💥

🔨 Smack – SMACK Brainrots and bring them to your base!
💸 Upgrade – Make your hammer stronger and your Brainrots richer!
🧬 Mutate – Some Brainrots can MUTATE into crazy rare forms worth BIG money!
📈 Grind – Upgrade your hammers, upgrade your brainrots, and flex your rarest finds!

💵 EARN OFFLINE!

⚠️ Join the community to report bugs and get updated on the game ⚠️
